character: Detective O'Riley at Pippin Carter's murder scene
voice: Callous, accusatory, and professionally controlling without stage-Irish vocabulary or eye dialect.

entries.text: Quite a scream, Miss Bow. Did you kill him?
No! I... just walked in and found him.
That explains the scream. Did you see the murderer?
All right. We'll speak again when you've collected yourself. And don't try to leave the building.
